source_kind: User-supplied publisher PDF; all 9 pages read and visually inspected, including Figure 1 and Tables 1-5
population: Single-centre Beijing ChaoYang Hospital pilot randomized trial; 60 patients; 20 per arm; age >=40; >=15 teeth; GOLD II-IV; at least one site PD>3 mm and CAL>3 mm
endpoint: Participant classified as frequent exacerbator after reporting >=2 exacerbations in the preceding 12 months; NOT recurrent event counts or hospitalization counts
endpoint_source: PDF p3 / printed p566, Assessing exacerbations of COPD
table5_source: PDF p7 / printed p570, Table 5 and footnote; year2 ORs also in Results PDF p5 / printed p568
adjustment: baseline frequent exacerbations in the preceding 12 months
discrepancy_resolution: Original Table 5 and Results both give Scaling year2 OR 0.04. The value 0.004 is also Table 4's omnibus chi-square P value, not this OR. This does not establish how a secondary review acquired its different OR.
maintenance: PDF p4 / printed p567: SRP repeated if necessary at 6, 12, 24 months; scaling group received maintenance supragingival scaling at follow-up. Actual quantities and costs not reported.
source_caveats: Table 1 prints Scaling female 5 (15), although 5/20=25%; preserve count and flag source percentage inconsistency, not silently correct original.

Figure 1 reports n=20 analyzed per arm but available follow-up counts differ; Table 4 follows available denominators. Missing-data/imputation details for reported adjusted regressions cannot be recovered from aggregate tables.
Pulmonary-function paragraph on printed p568 says lower where Table 3 and surrounding interpretation show higher values; not used as a numerical model input.
No severity-specific exacerbation rates, hospitalization efficacy, event utility, or resource quantities are reported.
The difference between significant year2 and nonsignificant year1 results is not a test of time-by-treatment interaction.
